medications.purpose: Control blood pressure as first‑line therapy
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 step 1 recommends ACE‑I for hypertension in non‑Afro‑Caribbean adults; titrate to maximum tolerated dose

medications.purpose: Add CCB to achieve BP target when ACE‑I monotherapy insufficient
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 step 2 recommends ACE‑I + CCB combination if BP not at target
Not part of hypertension guideline; continued for pain control

assumptions_warnings: eGFR and serum potassium not available – assumed eGFR ≥45 mL/min/1.73 m² and K⁺ ≤4.5 mmol/L; labs required before dose increase.
Patient age and ethnicity not recorded – ACE‑I appropriate for non‑Afro‑Caribbean adults; if patient is ≥55 yr or Afro‑Caribbean, CCB would be preferred.
Pregnancy status unknown – ACE‑I contraindicated in pregnancy; confirm patient is not pregnant before up‑titration.
QRISK cardiovascular risk score not calculated – NICE NG136 recommends assessment; arrange QRISK evaluation.
BMI, smoking, alcohol intake not documented – address lifestyle factors per NICE non‑pharmacological recommendations.
treatment_summary: Increase lisinopril to 20 mg daily and add amlodipine 5 mg daily to achieve target BP <140/90 mmHg, with ongoing monitoring of renal function, electrolytes and BP. Continue acetaminophen for pain. Arrange baseline labs, pregnancy check, QRISK assessment and reinforce lifestyle modifications per NICE NG136.
